item.title: National First-Generation Student Week | November 2nd-6th, 2026
item.description: The Office of Inclusive Excellence (O.I.E.) is happy to announce this year’s National First-Gen Week events being held Monday, November 02 through Friday, November 06! This week is about campus events that empower first-generation students to learn about what resources are available as well as connecting with fellow first-generation students, faculty, and staff!

item.title: Spring 2027 Discovery Semester Registration is Open!
item.description: Date: Wednesday, October 21, 2026 (all day) - Are you looking to satisfy your Discovery Semester this upcoming Spring? Do you have an internship secured or a plan in mind? Register your experience in Handshake now under ‘Career Center’! The deadline to register a Spring 2027 experience is January 26. Reach out to CCPD at ccpd@rpi.edu if you have questions!

item.title: Quantum Optimization for Feature Selection in Biomedical Data Online Workshop
item.description: Henry Liu of RPI will present research on feature selection for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) metabolomics data on Wednesday, 10/21/26 from 10:00 - 11:30 am. The work uses a QUBO formulation and quantum optimization to identify a small set of informative biomarkers from a rapidly growing space of possible feature combinations. For more information and link to join the workshop, please visit https://foci.rpi.edu/news-and-events

item.title: RPI Faculty In-Person Workshop - Designing Assignments with AI in Mind
item.description: Date: Tuesday, October 27, 2026 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM - This one-hour introductory session will provide practical ideas for adapting assignments while keeping learning at the center. We will explore examples from a variety of disciplines, discuss different approaches to student AI use, and share simple strategies that can help instructors rethink assignments without starting from scratch. Please click the link in the See section to register by Friday, October 23rd. Space is limited.

item.title: Leading from Anywhere: Frontline Leadership
item.description:
At RPI, we maintain that “leadership” involves a learnable set of actions and behaviors that is available to everyone. Whether it be leading a particular project or initiative, assisting others in overcoming obstacles and capitalizing on opportunities, or catalyzing co-creation with colleagues, Rensselaer community members model leadership every day.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
